## Core Capabilities & Specializations
1. **Autonomous AI Systems**: LLM agents with multi-step reasoning, dynamic memory graphs, tool-calling pipelines, adaptive prompting engines, and autonomous execution.
2. **Cybersecurity & Offensive Security**: Red-teaming, wireless reconnaissance, Wi-Fi packet injection, exploit simulation, vulnerability research, network analysis, and hardened defenses.
3. **Human × Machine Hardware & Bionics**: EMG-controlled neural-signal driven bionic prosthetics, micro-controller firmware (ESP32, STM32, Arduino), custom PCB design, and sensor fusion.
4. **Edge Intelligence & AR/XR**: Lightweight augmented reality smart glasses prototypes (XR-01), on-device edge computing, computer vision, and wearable interfaces.
5. **Full-Stack Engineering & Rapid Prototyping**: Production velocity frameworks, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, distributed APIs, and scalable real-time architectures shipped from idea to deployment in 48 hours.

## Featured Projects

- [XBionics](https://www.krishnakr.com/#work): EMG-Controlled Neural Bionic Arm translating biological muscle impulses into mechanical articulation via real-time signal processing and custom embedded PCB controllers.
- [BlackESP](https://www.krishnakr.com/#work): Portable offensive pentesting device built on ESP32 microcontrollers for wireless reconnaissance, 802.11 packet injection, and field red-team operations.
- [FinalRound](https://www.krishnakr.com/#work): Voice-based AI interview simulation system utilizing LLM-driven conversations, dynamic memory graphs, and adaptive prompting for real-time interview coaching.
- [XR-01](https://www.krishnakr.com/#work): Experimental lightweight augmented reality glasses with on-device edge intelligence, multi-sensor fusion, and computer vision overlays.
- [Rapid Prototyping Framework](https://www.krishnakr.com/#work): High-velocity engineering stack and reusable architecture for building and deploying functional full-stack products within 48 hours.
